performance_case.causal_mechanism: Point-in-time active-buy pressure above the contemporaneous book midline may precede short-horizon continuation, while V3R1 source-liveness selection prevents transport gaps or rejected days from masquerading as market evidence.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This fourteen-selected-day diagnostic may discover one directional mechanism only. It cannot establish fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, capacity, candidate readiness, OOS value, deployment or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Drawdown improvement is MISSING_PROOF. A later separately frozen equal-capital DRA admission experiment would have to show that rejecting weak entries reduces path risk without materially degrading participation or total PnL.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The fixed calendar budget, first source-liveness-defined fourteen-day streak and one Local interpretation consume bounded time; a negative or ambiguous result closes the mechanism before a longer economic or OOS cycle.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: If the simplest frozen tier is positive at both 15 and 60 minutes versus strictly earlier matched controls, one later entry-admission hypothesis may improve fee-adjusted equal-capital DRA total PnL; otherwise the mechanism closes without tuning.
